method: Primary official pages reopened independently with web tool; paraphrased supported claims only.

sources.supports: Offsets need not be consecutive; commit next unfinished fetched position or batch next, preserving leader epoch. Poll thread owns consumer APIs; paused work still needs poll liveness.
nextOffsets returns post-poll positions plus metadata; fully completed batch may use that saved position rather than last record plus one.
Kafka transaction output/positions and read_committed; external DB/HTTP is a separate coordination boundary. Share groups are preview in 4.1 and differ from traditional group ownership.
Classic and consumer are protocol options, not a generic synonym for traditional groups.
Rowid-table primary keys can contain NULL absent explicit NOT NULL; WITHOUT ROWID and STRICT differ.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately; another writer can cause SQLITE_BUSY.
orTimeout completes the future exceptionally; cancellation does not directly control the underlying computation.
preStop runs within grace; endpoint updates and local shutdown overlap; elapsed grace may force SIGKILL. Replacement Pods have a new identity.
Scheduler selects a node/binds the Pod; kubelet executes through the container runtime.
Startup, readiness and liveness have distinct roles; readiness supplies endpoint eligibility rather than desired capacity.
